title: kbmon --status sprints --backtest N replays the estimator over the last N closed sprints and prints its error and range coverage
goal: kbmon.py --status sprints --backtest N replays mon_eta.estimate over the last N sprints closed on origin/main at 25, 50 and 75 percent of the time from each one's start commit to its close commit, a sprint replayed only when another closed before its start; at each point it rebuilds the sprint's items, those whose file at their claim commit names the sprint, as done (a done commit at or before the point), in progress (claimed at or before it) or to do, with the history of the items done and the sprints closed before the point; it prints one line per sprint and the summary line `backtest: sprints=S points=P median absolute error=E min median relative error=R% inside the range=C%`, where a point's error is the distance from the middle of the range to the actual minutes left, relative to those minutes; --backtest without --status sprints, or with N below 1, exits 2 naming --status sprints

run:
import json,os,re,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
d=tempfile.mkdtemp();c=os.path.join(d,"c");os.makedirs(c+"/kb/_self/backlog")
env=dict(os.environ,CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=d+"/pd",CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=d+"/pr",GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull,GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1")
g=lambda *a,**k:s.run(["git","-C",c,*a],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True,env=dict(env,**k)).stdout
g("init","-q","-b","main");g("config","user.email","p@example.com");g("config","user.name","p")
open(c+"/backlog.json","w").write(json.dumps({"item_dir":"kb/_self/backlog"}))
B=1790000000
def commit(msg,at):
    a="@%d +0000"%(B+at*60);g("add","-A");g("commit","-q","--allow-empty","-m",msg,GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=a,GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=a)
def f(i):return c+"/kb/_self/backlog/%s.json"%i
for n,(sp,start,close) in enumerate((("SP-aaaaaaaa",0,120),("SP-bbbbbbbb",200,320),("SP-cccccccc",400,540))):
    a,r="ST-c%s000000"%sp[3],"ST-r"+sp[3:10]
    commit("chore(backlog): start %s \"t\""%sp,start)
    open(f(a),"w").write(json.dumps(dict(id=a,kind="story",title="t",status="doing",sprint=sp,touches=["_tools/x.py"])));commit("chore(backlog): claim %s \"t\""%a,start)
    commit("chore(backlog): done %s \"t\""%a,start+40)
    open(f(r),"w").write(json.dumps(dict(id=r,kind="story",title="t",status="doing",sprint=sp,review=True,touches=["kb/_self/backlog/**"])));commit("chore(backlog): claim %s \"t\""%r,start+40)
    commit("chore(backlog): done %s \"t\""%r,start+80)
    os.remove(f(a));os.remove(f(r));commit("chore(backlog): close %s \"t\""%sp,close)
g("update-ref","refs/remotes/origin/main","HEAD")
def bt(n):
    p=s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbmon.py","--status","sprints","--backtest",str(n),"--root",c],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120,env=env)
    print(p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr[-300:]);return p.returncode,p.stdout
r5,o5=bt(5);r1,o1=bt(1)
ok=("SP-bbbbbbbb" in o5 and "SP-cccccccc" in o5 and r5==0 and r1==0 and "backtest: sprints=2 points=6 median absolute error=10 min median relative error=10% inside the range=50%" in o5
    and "backtest: sprints=1 points=3 median absolute error=20 min median relative error=29% inside the range=0%" in o1)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import subprocess as s,sys; r=[s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbmon.py",*a],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60) for a in (["--backtest","3"],["--status","sprints","--backtest","0"])]; print([(x.returncode,x.stderr[-200:]) for x in r]); sys.exit(0 if all(x.returncode==2 and "--status sprints" in x.stderr for x in r) else 1)

clauses.clause: kbmon.py --status sprints --backtest N replays mon_eta.estimate over the last N sprints closed on origin/main at 25, 50 and 75 percent of the time from each one's start commit to its close commit, a sprint replayed only when another closed before its start

at each point it rebuilds the sprint's items, those whose file at their claim commit names the sprint, as done (a done commit at or before the point), in progress (claimed at or before it) or to do, with the history of the items done and the sprints closed before the point

it prints one line per sprint and the summary line `backtest: sprints=S points=P median absolute error=E min median relative error=R% inside the range=C%`, where a point's error is the distance from the middle of the range to the actual minutes left, relative to those minutes
--backtest without --status sprints, or with N below 1, exits 2 naming --status sprints

gates.question: Which backtest target does the sprint goal state?
options: median relative error at most 35 percent and half the close times inside the range over 20 sprints, labelled as not backed by data yet
no number until the backtest has run once
gates.recommendation: median relative error at most 35 percent and half the close times inside the range over 20 sprints, labelled as not backed by data yet
gates.answer: median relative error at most 35 percent and half the close times inside the range over 20 sprints, labelled as not backed by data yet

gates.question: Does --backtest N take the last N closed sprints and then leave out those no sprint preceded, or the last N sprints that can be replayed?
options: the last N closed, then leave out those no sprint preceded
gates.recommendation: the last N closed, then leave out those no sprint preceded
gates.answer: the last N closed, then leave out those no sprint preceded

gates.question: How does the replay order a sprint's open items and fill their after lists, which the live panel takes from the sprint's rank order?
options: claim order, following the items a depends_on names and the earlier-claimed items whose touches meet its own
no after lists: every open item runs on its own
gates.recommendation: claim order, following the items a depends_on names and the earlier-claimed items whose touches meet its own
gates.answer: claim order, following the items a depends_on names and the earlier-claimed items whose touches meet its own

notes: Premise on origin/main cf985537c, 2026-10-19: kbmon.py has no --backtest (argparse exits 2 on an unrecognised argument). Baseline on the same day, a planning script outside the repository: the commit-gap estimate (open items x the median gap of the last 5 done commits) over the last 20 closed sprints with at least 3 items and 10 minutes, at 25/50/75 percent of each (57 points): median absolute error 10 min, median relative error 51 percent. The sprint's target (relative error at most 35 percent, at least half the close times inside the range, over 20 sprints) has no data behind it for the new estimator yet; the review story's check measures it. Probe 2026-10-19, measured on this clone at origin/main (a35ab76c7 plus the work branch), command python3 _tools/kbmon.py --status sprints --backtest 20 (5.9 s wall): sprints=20 points=60 median absolute error=4.9 min median relative error=20% inside the range=67%.
